verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe supports account signup, reader registration/management from the Dashboard, and no-code payment acceptance, implying a founder could sign up and order hardware — but there's no explicit documentation of the approval/underwriting timeline, hardware ordering flow, or shipping speed that would confirm 'same week' turnaround. Community commentary focuses on integration effort and fees, not onboarding speed. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the signup-to-approval timeline, hardware ordering/checkout flow in the Dashboard, and shipping/delivery speed claims or corroboration.
